about: Real photographs for the demo workspace's album and #雑談 post (scripts/docs-shots-setup.mjs), from Wikimedia Commons, all CC0 (no attribution required). The setup downloads `url` (Commons' 1920 px rendition; 1280 px wide for a portrait) into a cache outside the repository and checks `sha256`; the photo files are not committed.
